Bodybuilding coaching, in person and online
I help people get stronger, build muscle and feel at home in the gym. You get a plan you can actually follow, and a coach who notices when something is off.
I'm a bodybuilder and personal trainer. I write plans that fit your week, watch your technique, and change the plan when your progress asks for it.
Most people don't need a perfect plan. They need a plan they can actually follow, and someone who notices when something is off. That is what I do.

I look at where you are now, set a goal we can measure, and adjust along the way. I work with beginners who feel lost in the gym, lifters who stopped progressing and people who want to compete on stage. If you are somewhere in between, we can talk about it.
